messages.subject: cyclic spline by group
parts:
Is it possible to have a cyclic spline being fitted by group? Such as:
library(mgcv)
set.seed(0)
n<-200;sig2<-4
x1 <- runif(n, 0, 1);x2 <- runif(n, 0, 1);x3 <- runif(n, 0, 1)
fac<-c(rep(1,n/2),rep(2,n/2)) # create factor
fac.1<-rep(0,n)+(fac==1);fac.2<-1-fac.1 # and dummy variables
fac<-as.factor(fac)
f1 <-  exp(2 * x1) - 3.75887
f2 <-  0.2 * x1^11 * (10 * (1 - x1))^6 + 10 * (10 * x1)^3 * (1 - x1)^10
f<-f1*fac.1+f2*fac.2+x2
e <- rnorm(n, 0, sqrt(abs(sig2)))
y <- f + e

b<-gam(y~fac+s(x1,by=fac, bs = "cc")+x2)

Example is  not tailored for a cyclic example, sorry about that...

messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] cyclic spline by group
parts:
The Tokyo rainfall example in the recent JSS paper,
http://opus.bath.ac.uk/45256/
uses a cyclical spline.
Not sure what precisely what model you are looking for regarding the factors though, but the spline model above can be replicated and grouped etc, like other f() models in inla.

Finn
